originality.rationale: The exact optimized one-latitude pure-quadrupole restriction-Gram theorem, including the dimension-four two-design equality, was not implied by the inspected primary relevant literature or the closest published result statements located in targeted searches. Elementary fourth moments, standard separation by spherical harmonic order, and the classical general notion of latitude sampling are acknowledged as prior tools; no claim of unique priority beyond best knowledge. The most material residual risk is an implicit older polynomial-design classification in representation-theoretic or experimental-design work.
residual_risks: A classical special-function, representation-theoretic or continuous spherical experimental-design formula could implicitly dominate the result despite dissimilar titles.

The Slepian-wavelet paper was checked only at abstract level and is not used as evidence of full-document exclusion.

value.rationale: Continuous latitude measurements for spherical quadrupoles are a natural exact restricted-sampling model; frame stability and the exceptional noninjective latitude matter when observations are constrained to one elevation. An exact all-dimension E-optimal solution has a substantive boundary d=4 with two distinct sharp designs, rather than a small numerical improvement. The results are not an arbitrary isolated parameter evaluation. The objective, probability normalization, and exclusion of arbitrary/digital designs are unambiguous.
